===== Helper scripts and fakes (full bodies) =====

----- /tmp/claude-1000/-home-ksabada-projects-AI-course-2026-agentic-engineering-crash-course-capstone/4034e690-c8bb-4005-a19e-8b3d5038ed0e/scratchpad/rec15.sh -----
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Usage: rec15.sh '<command>'
# Runs <command> with `bash -c` in the project dir, appends "# <UTC time>", "$ <command>",
# the combined stdout/stderr, and "[exit N]" (N measured with $?) to checks.txt, and echoes the same.
cd /home/ksabada/projects/AI_course/2026-agentic-engineering-crash-course-capstone/submissions/kostyasabada || exit 99
export PATH=/tmp/node-v24.21.0-linux-x64/bin:$PATH
out=docs/evidence/add-realtime-chat-room-1-5/checks.txt
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$out")"
{
  printf '\n# %s\n$ %s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$1"
  bash -c "$1" 2>&1
  printf '[exit %s]\n' "$?"
} | tee -a "$out"

----- /tmp/claude-1000/-home-ksabada-projects-AI-course-2026-agentic-engineering-crash-course-capstone/4034e690-c8bb-4005-a19e-8b3d5038ed0e/scratchpad/sidefx15.sh -----
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Usage: sidefx15.sh <label> <command...>
# Run from the project dir. Records working-tree fingerprints, runs the command (its stdout/stderr
# shown, exit code and duration measured), records the fingerprints again, and diffs them.
# Fingerprints: `git status --short` (verbatim), SHA-256 of `git status --short --untracked-files=all`,
# of `git status --short --ignored`, and of the SHA-256 of every tracked regular file
# (symlinked directories under .claude/skills are skipped by sha256sum and covered by git status).
set -u
label=$1; shift
fp() {
  git status --short
  echo "untracked-all: $(git status --short --untracked-files=all | sha256sum | cut -c1-16)"
  echo "ignored:       $(git status --short --ignored | sha256sum | cut -c1-16)"
  echo "tracked-files: $(git ls-files -z | xargs -0 sha256sum 2>/dev/null | sha256sum | cut -c1-16)"
}
before=$(fp)
echo "--- fingerprints before ($label)"; echo "$before"
echo "--- output"
start=$(date +%s%N)
"$@"
rc=$?
echo "--- script exit: $rc; duration_ms: $(( ($(date +%s%N) - start) / 1000000 ))"
after=$(fp)
if [ "$before" = "$after" ]; then echo "--- fingerprints after: identical (git status --short unchanged)"; else echo "--- fingerprints after: DIFFERENT"; diff <(echo "$before") <(echo "$after"); fi

<summary><strong>Telemetry</strong></summary>

OpenSpec collects anonymous usage stats.

We collect only command names and version to understand usage patterns. No arguments, paths, content, or PII. Automatically disabled in CI.

**Opt-out (any one is enough):**
- `openspec config set telemetry.enabled false` (global config; unset means on)
- `export OPENSPEC_TELEMETRY=0` or `export DO_NOT_TRACK=1` (env overrides config)

===== Round 2 helper scripts and fakes (full bodies; rec15.sh and fake-node-hang/node as above) =====

----- /tmp/claude-1000/-home-ksabada-projects-AI-course-2026-agentic-engineering-crash-course-capstone/4034e690-c8bb-4005-a19e-8b3d5038ed0e/scratchpad/sidefx15b.sh -----
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Usage: sidefx15b.sh <label> <command...>   (round 2 of task 1.5)
# Run from the project dir. Records fingerprints, runs the command (stdout/stderr shown, exit code
# and duration measured), records the fingerprints again, and diffs them.
# Fingerprints: `git status --short` (verbatim); SHA-256 of `git status --short --untracked-files=all`,
# of `git status --short --ignored`, and of the contents of every tracked regular file; the file list
# with sizes and mtimes of ~/.npm/_logs (count + hash); and the files, sizes, mtimes, and SHA-256 of
# ~/.config/openspec (the OpenSpec global config dir; XDG_CONFIG_HOME is unset here).
set -u
label=$1; shift
fp() {
  git status --short
  echo "untracked-all: $(git status --short --untracked-files=all | sha256sum | cut -c1-16)"
  echo "ignored:       $(git status --short --ignored | sha256sum | cut -c1-16)"
  echo "tracked-files: $(git ls-files -z | xargs -0 sha256sum 2>/dev/null | sha256sum | cut -c1-16)"
  echo "npm-logs:      $(ls ~/.npm/_logs | wc -l) files, list $(ls -l --time-style=+%s.%N ~/.npm/_logs | sha256sum | cut -c1-16)"
  echo "openspec-cfg:  $(ls -la --time-style=+%s.%N ~/.config/openspec 2>&1 | sha256sum | cut -c1-16), content $(cat ~/.config/openspec/* 2>&1 | sha256sum | cut -c1-16)"
}
before=$(fp)
echo "--- fingerprints before ($label)"; echo "$before"
echo "--- output"
start=$(date +%s%N)
"$@"
rc=$?
echo "--- script exit: $rc; duration_ms: $(( ($(date +%s%N) - start) / 1000000 ))"
after=$(fp)
if [ "$before" = "$after" ]; then echo "--- fingerprints after: identical"; else echo "--- fingerprints after: DIFFERENT"; diff <(echo "$before") <(echo "$after"); fi

#!/bin/sh
# fake node: fails with stderr noise
echo "simulated node failure" >&2
exit 1

----- /tmp/claude-1000/-home-ksabada-projects-AI-course-2026-agentic-engineering-crash-course-capstone/4034e690-c8bb-4005-a19e-8b3d5038ed0e/scratchpad/fake-node-ignore-term/node -----
#!/bin/sh
# fake node: ignores SIGTERM and finishes after 13 s (limitation probe)
trap "" TERM
sleep 13

----- /tmp/claude-1000/-home-ksabada-projects-AI-course-2026-agentic-engineering-crash-course-capstone/4034e690-c8bb-4005-a19e-8b3d5038ed0e/scratchpad/rebuild-workflow.py -----
# Rebuilds docs/workflow.md from the HEAD version plus the task 1.5 edits (round 2 wording).
# Reads the HEAD copy fully into memory before opening the target for writing.
head_path = '/tmp/claude-1000/-home-ksabada-projects-AI-course-2026-agentic-engineering-crash-course-capstone/4034e690-c8bb-4005-a19e-8b3d5038ed0e/scratchpad/workflow-head.md'
target = 'docs/workflow.md'
with open(head_path) as f:
    s = f.read()
old = ("An agent loop script and a Claude Code `SessionStart` context hook are planned for the first OpenSpec change (see `architecture.md`); neither exists yet.\n\n"
       "Documentation: https://github.com/Fission-AI/OpenSpec.\n")
assert s.endswith(old), 'unexpected HEAD ending'
new = ("The first OpenSpec change adds the agent loop script `scripts/agent-loop.sh` (see `architecture.md`) and a session context hook (next section).\n\n"
       "Documentation: https://github.com/Fission-AI/OpenSpec.\n\n"
       "## Session context hook\n\n"
       "The committed project settings `.claude/settings.json` register a Claude Code `SessionStart` hook (sources `startup`, `resume`, `clear`, `compact`) that runs `scripts/session-context.sh`. "
       "The script runs the pinned CLI directly, `OPENSPEC_TELEMETRY=0 ./node_modules/.bin/openspec list --json`, and prints its output, which Claude Code adds to the new session's context. "
       "It does not use `npm run`, because npm writes debug logs under `~/.npm/_logs` on every run, and the telemetry opt-out keeps OpenSpec from creating its global config file (user decision, design D8). "
       "If the CLI or `node` is missing, the command fails, or it takes longer than 10 seconds, the script prints a one-line notice with the manual command (`npm run --silent openspec -- list --json`) instead; it always exits 0 and writes no files. "
       "Requirements: `openspec/changes/add-realtime-chat-room/specs/session-context-hook/spec.md`. "
       "In a real Claude Code 2.1.198 session the hook ran and its output was recorded, but that session could not authenticate, so the model receiving the text has not been observed yet; a user-run session is planned as follow-up evidence (`docs/evidence/add-realtime-chat-room-1-5/hook-output.txt`).\n\n"
       "Codex: no automatic injection is configured. Codex is not installed in this environment (`command -v codex` fails), so no installed version's `--help` could be checked. "
       "The official Codex hooks documentation (https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/hooks, redirected from https://developers.openai.com/codex/hooks, read 2026-09-26) describes a comparable `SessionStart` hook in `<repo>/.codex/hooks.json` or `.codex/config.toml`: plain-text stdout becomes extra developer context, commands run in the session's working directory, and project hooks run only after the user reviews and trusts them (`/hooks`). "
       "This equivalent has not been configured or run here, so parity is not claimed. Until a verified run exists, Codex agents run `npm run --silent openspec -- list --json` themselves at the start of a task.\n")
s = s[:-len(old)] + new
with open(target, 'w') as f:
    f.write(s)
